svg.title: Вращение плеча наружу с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Correct this to external rotation with the working elbow fixed at VIEWER'S LEFT side of each man's torso. LEFT panel: elbow against ribs on viewer-left, forearm crosses belly so fist is near navel. RIGHT panel: elbow stays at viewer-left ribs, forearm rotates OUT to VIEWER'S LEFT so fist is OUTSIDE left silhouette at waist height. Upper arm never swings or crosses body. In BOTH panels band wall-eye anchor must be on VIEWER'S RIGHT of the man, opposite the working elbow. Band goes from RIGHT wall-eye across belly to working fist. Delete old left wall eyes. Preserve hollow white contour anatomy, pure black interiors/background and two whole figures. NO gray/white fills, shading, text or arrows. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
